mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS project_character_id, pc.project_id, pc.character_id, c.canonical_name, c.aliases::text AS character_aliases_json, pc.project_aliases::text AS project_aliases_json, pc.role, pc.importance, pc.pinned_character_version_id, cv.bible, cv.visual_prompt, cv.status AS version_status, cv.locked_at AS version_locked_at, cai.ai_name, cai.aliases_json::text AS ai_aliases_json FROM project_characters pc JOIN characters c ON c.id = pc.character_id LEFT JOIN character_versions cv ON cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id LEFT JOIN project_character_ai_identities cai ON cai.project_id = pc.project_id AND cai.project_character_id = pc.id WHERE pc.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT pl.id AS project_location_id, pl.project_id, pl.name, pl.description, pl.visual_prompt, lai.ai_name, lai.aliases_json::text AS ai_aliases_json FROM project_locations pl LEFT JOIN project_location_ai_identities lai ON lai.project_id = pl.project_id AND lai.project_location_id = pl.id WHERE pl.project_id = #{projectId} AND pl.status = 'ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO characters (row_version, created_at, updated_at, canonical_name, aliases, status) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{canonicalName}, CAST(COALESCE(#{aliasesJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), #{status}) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO character_versions (row_version, created_at, updated_at, character_id, version_number, bible, visual_prompt, status, locked_at) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{characterId}, #{versionNumber}, #{bible}, #{visualPrompt}, #{status}, #{lockedAt}) RETURNING id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) FROM character_versions WHERE character_id = #{characterId}

INSERT INTO project_characters (row_version, created_at, updated_at, project_id, character_id, role, importance, project_aliases, story_metadata, groups_json, pinned_character_version_id, status) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{projectId}, #{characterId}, #{role}, #{importance}, CAST(COALESCE(#{projectAliasesJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), #{storyMetadata}, CAST(COALESCE(#{groupsJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), #{pinnedCharacterVersionId}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (project_id, character_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_character_ai_identities (row_version, created_at, updated_at, project_id, project_character_id, ai_name, aliases_json, is_active) VALUES (0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{projectId}, #{projectCharacterId}, #{aiName}, CAST(COALESCE(#{aliasesJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), true) ON CONFLICT (project_id, project_character_id) DO UPDATE SET ai_name = #{aiName}, aliases_json = CAST(COALESCE(#{aliasesJson}, '[]') AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: INSERT INTO project_locations (row_version, created_at, updated_at, project_id, name, description, visual_prompt, reference_image_url, status) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{projectId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{visualPrompt}, #{referenceImageUrl}, #{status}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_location_ai_identities (row_version, created_at, updated_at, project_id, project_location_id, ai_name, aliases_json, is_active) VALUES (0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{projectId}, #{projectLocationId}, #{aiName}, CAST(#{aliasesJson} AS jsonb), true) ON CONFLICT (project_id, project_location_id) DO UPDATE SET ai_name = #{aiName}, aliases_json = CAST(#{aliasesJson} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INSERT INTO scene_characters (scene_id, order_index, project_character_id) VALUES (#{sceneId}, #{orderIndex}, #{projectCharacterId}) ON CONFLICT (scene_id, project_character_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO visual_beat_characters (visual_beat_id, project_character_id, role) VALUES (#{visualBeatId}, #{projectCharacterId}, #{role}) ON CONFLICT (visual_beat_id, project_character_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT scene_id, order_index, project_character_id FROM scene_characters WHERE scene_id = #{sceneId} ORDER BY order_index, project_character_id
SELECT visual_beat_id, project_character_id, role FROM visual_beat_characters WHERE visual_beat_id = #{visualBeatId} ORDER BY project_character_id

SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, project_id, name, description, visual_prompt, reference_image_url, status FROM project_locations WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY name, id
